digest.component_or_area: pytest temporary directory management and nested test execution
propositions: Nested pytest children executed without a private --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and may delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories at session finish
Tests test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py launch executing nested pytest subprocesses that allocate shared numbered roots without passing a parent-owned --basetemp

Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for numbered roots; sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None, causing executing children to delete unrelated trees
Safe nested launchers in tests/_store_isolation.py and tests/unit/test_external_isolation.py pass tmp_path-derived --basetemp to children; the two confirmed unsafe sites must adopt the same pattern
Parent-owned basetemp assignments (tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest and tmp_path/standalone-pytest) prevent nested children from accessing the shared numbered root cleanup mechanism
